description: This file contains GPIO driver implementation for Microchip XEC hardware in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, interrupt handling, and port control functions.

methods.name: gpio_xec_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, handling direction, pull-up/down, open drain, and initial output state.

methods.name: gpio_xec_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger type for a GPIO pin, enabling or disabling interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_xec_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO port bits atomically based on mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_xec_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specified bits in GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_xec_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specified bits in GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_xec_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specified bits in GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_xec_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads current raw input value of GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_xec_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration for GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_gpio_xec_port_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO port, handles interrupt source clearing and callback firing.
